[Manual 18 — Quick FAQ]
House manual > 18. Quick FAQ

**What time can I check in and out?** Check-in is from 2:00 PM and check-out is by 11:00 AM.

**Is there a cleaning fee?** No. It is included in the nightly rate.

**Can I drink the tap water?** No. Use the filtered RO dispenser in the kitchen.

**What happens in a power cut?** The generator starts in about 30 seconds. Lifts, lights, Wi-Fi, fridge and one AC keep running.

**Is smoking allowed?** Only in the marked corner of the roof terrace.

**Can friends visit?** Yes, between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM, up to 4 at a time, registered at Gate 2. No overnight visitors.

**Is there a washing machine?** Yes in the One-Bedroom, Two-Bedroom and Penthouse. Studio guests use the shared laundry room (PKR 400 per wash).

**Where do I park?** In the basement (B1) through Gate 1, one space per apartment (two for the Penthouse).

**What if I am locked out?** Call the host or the emergency maintenance line (section 13.4).

**Who can approve a refund or a special request?** Only the host (section 2.8).

[Manual 1.4 — How fast do we reply?]
House manual > 1. Welcome to Lahore Heights > 1.4 How fast do we reply?

Your host replies to messages within 30 minutes between 9:00 AM and 11:00 PM. Messages sent overnight (11:00 PM to 9:00 AM) are answered by 9:30 AM. For urgent problems, do not wait for a message reply: call the emergency maintenance line.

[Guide Lahore > Go next]
Lahore > Go next

It is a popular picnic spot spread over 50 acres with a lake and rowboats, motorboats, children's park, swimming pool, cafeteria, canteen and rest houses

48 Hiran Minar (About 35 km away, near Sheikhupura). A peaceful rural park with a lake and minaret. It used to be favourite hunting sport of the Muslim kings, especially the Mughals. Jehangir erected the pavilion-like monument to commemorate the death of his pet deer (Hiran means deer). It served a double purpose as from its top the hunters could locate the habitations of deer. It is a beautiful picnic as well as a historic spot. A high Bara Dari Ghat is constructed right in middle of a Talab. A man made big lake, boating facility is also available. A good garden lay out is surrounding the place. (updated Feb 2017)

The ancient city of Harappa was one of the first Indus Valley excavation sites; a must see if you're into archaeology. Harappa lies about 300 km southwest of Lahore

[Guide Lahore > Eat > Splurge]
Lahore > Eat > Splurge

A globally famous restaurant chain.

Costa Nostra. Authentic Italian food, overseen by Pak-Italian owners. It has a reservation-only, high-end gourmet experience with a rather well put-together table d'hote, and it has a basement pizzeria where you can't go wrong if want a pizza pie that resembles something from Rome and not Chicago.

The Monal, in Gulberg III near Liberty Chowk, roundabout. It on the top of Liberty Park Plaza. You have to climb up the plaza by a car, but be careful to drive slowly and look in the traffic mirrors to see if a car is coming from the upper floor when you're about to climb up in the plaza. The Monal has indoor and outdoor seating and it shows a total sky view of the bustling city. ☏ +91 42 35789824
